pr_body:
Motivation:
Netty provides a convenient decoding tool class ByteToMessageDecoder, this class has accumulate bulk unpacking capability, can read bytes from the socket as much as possible, and then synchronously call the decode method to decode the business object. And compose a List. Finally, the traversal traverses the List and submits it to ChannelPipeline for processing.

Modification:
Here we made a small change, as shown in the bottom half of the figure, the content to be submitted is changed from a single command to the entire List, which reduces the number of pipeline executions and improves throughput.

Result:
This mode has no advantage in low-concurrency scenarios, and has a significant performance boost in boost throughput in high-concurrency scenarios.
AbstractBatchDecoder and ByteToMessageDecoder have the same performance for both messages and rpc calls in low concurrency situations. But AbstractBatchDecoder, compared to ByteToMessageDecoder, has its batch processing features that make it
Significant performance gains can be achieved with high concurrency, over 10% over repeated tests, and the smaller the size of the request, the greater the performance improvement.Report of performance benchmark by [sofa-bolt](https://github.com/sofastack/sofa-bolt) will be open source in December 2019.
This pull request is based on 4.1 branch.

Fixes #9637
